A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] was the '''father''' of [[Xivhkalrainik]], who was enslaved and captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but managed to become a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]. Xivhkalrainik (also known as Xalek) kept in contact with his father, who was a husband to several wives, and who ultimately passed away during his son's apprenticeship to Kallig. Xalek was allowed to give his father a proper burial on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] so he could ascend to godhood.

Around [[3631 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> Xalek, now a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], visited his father's shrine on Ilum, to discover it had been desecrated by [[Miner/Legends|miners]]. Enraged, Xalek began a campaign of terror and revenge against them, eventually coming face-to-face with [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], who helped him restore his father's honor.<ref name="Dishonor">{{TORcite|type=general|Death Before Dishonor|Ilum}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Xivhkalrainik's father is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Xalek companion storyline. He is once again mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion during the Alliance alert ''Death Before Dishonor'', in which the Alliance Commander can potentially recruit Xalek to the Alliance. The Commander can either allow Xalek to murder the miners for Dark Side points, make him stop for Light Side points, or have Xalek spare the miners in exchange for building a small temple to his father for Light Side points.
